_notes: PocketPilot eval suite v1 (E1 spec). READ-ONLY goals only: the E2 runner executes every goal from Home with RunPolicy.readOnly and presses Home between goals.

Pass semantics (E2 judges): Outcome must be .completed via done(). Every specified pass field must hold. summaryContains: ALL substrings present (case-insensitive). summaryMatchesRegex: ICU regex against the done summary. summaryMinLength: summary character count. finalApp: case-insensitive equality with the final frontmost briefName (Home Screen for SpringBoard).
Operator setup: clear first-run onboarding/sheets once per app before running (Weather location, Translate data, Tips welcome). Goals assume steady state.

v1 limitations: summary truthfulness is NOT verified (a model can claim 'found it' without finding it); screen-state assertions (AX snapshot contains X) are deferred to Q1 on-device frames. S3 unknown-region refusals may fail icon-heavy goals; E2 should log abandon/refusal reasons per goal so the suite measures S3's false-positive rate.
Loading: E2 (DEBUG runner) loads this file, e.g. via Bundle.module with a .process resource entry, or by repo-relative path in DEBUG builds.

goals.goal: Open Settings, go to General > About, and report the iOS version. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains an iOS version number such as 26.1
goals.notes: Deep in-app navigation plus value read.

goals.goal: Open Settings, open Battery, and report the battery percentage. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a percentage such as 82%

goals.goal: Open Settings, scroll until you find 'Privacy & Security', and report that you found it. Do not change anything.
goals.notes: Scroll-to-find; entering the pane is unnecessary. Summary-truthfulness caveat applies.

goals.goal: Open Settings, go into General, then navigate back to the main Settings page and report done. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary confirms back on the main Settings page
goals.notes: Back-out navigation. Weak v1 assertion: final screen is not verified, only the app.

goals.goal: Open Weather and report today's high temperature. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a temperature such as 24°
goals.notes: Needs network. If a location prompt appears, S2 refuses both Allow and Don't Allow (whole-word 'allow'), so clear onboarding once up front.

goals.goal: Open Clock, go to the World Clock tab, and report the listed cities. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary names World Clock cities
goals.notes: City list varies by user config, so the pass key is the section name.

goals.goal: Open Stocks and report the current price of Apple (AAPL). Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a decimal price such as 232.14

goals.goal: Open Calculator and report what the display shows. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains the displayed digit(s)
goals.notes: No taps needed. Deliberately avoids interaction: S2 currently permits digit buttons.

goals.goal: Open the App Store, switch to the Apps tab, and report one app name you see there. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary names the Apps tab and one visible app

goals.goal: Open the App Store, open the Apps tab, then go back to the Today tab and report done. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary confirms ending on Today

goals.goal: Open Podcasts, open the Browse tab, and report one featured show title. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a show title (free text)
goals.notes: Browse tab avoids the personal library.

goals.goal: Open Safari, open a page from Favorites, and report its title. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains the page title (free text)
goals.notes: Requires a non-empty Favorites; the start page shows Favorites by default. No typing.

goals.goal: Open Tips and report the title of one featured tip or collection. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a tip title (free text)
goals.notes: Static Apple content, no personal data.

goals.goal: Open Translate and report the selected language pair. Do not change anything.
goals.notes: Clear first-run sheets once up front.

goals.goal: Open Settings, then open Weather, and report the current temperature. Do not change anything.
goals.answerShape: done summary contains a temperature such as 24°
goals.notes: Cross-app. S1 auto-finish must NOT trigger: this is not a pure-open goal.
